For each f, N_m=3^m+1+sum_{x in F_{3^m}}chi_m(f(x)), and B4=(N4-N2)/4. The exact field-character script exhausts all 3^11=177147 monic degree-11 polynomials over F3 (not a sample); exactly 21 have B4<4, with B4=0 or 2, and all 21 have positive-degree gcd(f,f'). The displayed witness has gcd=1, N2=18, N4=34 and B4=4. Independent finite-field arithmetic and squarefree checks rederived the exact counts; exhaustive finite classification is a complete proof for this FINITE domain, not for other genera/strata.
